pages.text: “Rich and mellow, the oath of the vine.”$(br2)Vanilla originates from the humid and dense tropical rainforest, where its delicate white flowers and slender pods intertwine to produce a faintly sweet and intoxicating aroma. It symbolizes warmth and blessings, widely used in flavoring, tinctures, and ceremonial celebrations.

Vanilla often clings to tree trunks and vines in rainforests, requiring a warm and moist environment to thrive. Travelers who find mature vanilla pods in the wild can collect seeds for artificial cultivation.

Vanilla must be harvested by $(l)right-clicking with shears$() when mature to avoid damaging the entire plant. The collected pods can be further sun-dried and fermented to release their rich sweetness, making them ideal for crafting desserts or brewing fragrant syrups.
